package.name: amr_slam
package.description: Correlative scan-matching SLAM for the AMR stack (C++/ROS 2 port of amr/slam). Library: a 2D SLAM front-end that fuses odometry increments with a two-stage correlative scan match against a blurred occupancy score map derived from a keyframed log-odds map (amr_mapping). Node: slam_node wraps the library, publishes the live /map and the map->odom correction, and serves /save_map.
